# resent date

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:resentDate`](gmeow-resentDate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/resentDate>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

The RFC 5322 Resent-Date header value of a message. Non-functional: a message may carry multiple Resent-Date values if it was resent multiple times. The raw header value remains on [`gmeow:MessageHeader`](../classes/gmeow-MessageHeader.md) ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:EmailMessage`](../classes/gmeow-EmailMessage.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)
